latency_note: Deep is the default for chat and for the reason tool. On a small CPU model a single generation often takes several seconds to a minute, and a deep answer can add a planner call plus one call per model step, so it is several times a single reply. Arithmetic, dates, and unit conversions are computed with tools and do not call a model. Profile fast on chat is the previous single-pass path. Profile fast on the reason tool still uses the engine, with the smaller budget above.
